warnings: Axes: x = grids 1-10 at 3.00 (27.00); y = rows A-B at 6.00 (single-bay classroom block, สปช. 101/26). Origin A1 (A is printed above B on every plan). Scanned government set; every value read off the page image.
The building has two levels (open ground floor ใต้ถุนโล่ง + upper classroom floor) although the folder name says 1 ชั้น — the name comes from the batch allocation and was not changed.

B' (6.80) is the 0.80 tick below B on S-01/S-02 (column C2 on the F3 combined footing, end of the grid-3 G1 stub). B'' (7.00) is the 1.00 right-hand chain below B on S-02 (GS slab edge) and A-08. B''' (7.60) is the 1.60 left chain on S-02/S-03/A-08 (upper-floor corridor edge). B'''' (7.90) is the 1.90 roof overhang. Primed in position order after B.
Before A: A' (-1.90) roof edge, A'' (-1.60) outer edge of the ทางเท้า on A-08 (1.00 + 0.60), A''' (-1.00) GS slab edge. They share the A prime sequence in reading order (section 4).
S-02's left chain looked like 1.80 at thumbnail size; zoomed it reads 1.60, matching S-03 and A-08 (three sheets agree).

Dimension sweep covers the structural plans S-01..S-05, the truss elevations on S-10 and the building section A-08 (for levels). Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: A-03..A-07, A-09..A-18 and E-01/E-02. Member-internal dimensions on S-06..S-09 (footing sizes and pile spacing, beam sections, stair treads/risers, G3/B4 elevations) stay on their elements.
